name: Booking
description: Full appointment booking, including the practitioner-logic capabilities absorbed from the Booking+ plugin. Services with categories, locations, resources, add-ons, per-staff pricing and group tiers; provider schedules with breaks and date overrides; group, recurring and walk-in bookings; an embeddable /book widget with self-service cancel and reschedule; Stripe payments (free/full/deposit), coupons, gift cards, refunds and invoices; email and SMS/WhatsApp reminders. The four capability flags below gate the absorbed Booking+ behaviour: per-service minimum-advance-days and prerequisite-service gates (service_rules), the client 'human message' door with its 8-hour practitioner nudge (client_messaging), type-reserved slots (slot_restrictions), and the multi-tier reminder cadence (custom_reminders).
author: Slate

client_messaging.name: Client Messaging & Inquiries
client_messaging.description: Client-facing personal message note on booking with practitioner reply thread and automated nudge alerts.

service_rules.name: Advanced Service Rules & Prerequisites
service_rules.description: Per-service preparation period gates (min advance days) and prerequisite service requirements with consultation forwarding.

slot_restrictions.name: Reserved Slot Windows
slot_restrictions.description: Reserve specific weekly time windows or practitioner hours exclusively for designated services.

custom_reminders.name: Multi-tier Custom Reminders & Overlays
custom_reminders.description: Service-specific 8-day / 1-day / 10-minute reminder templates with WhatsApp and Zoom link integration.
